summary.name: ACE inhibitor laboratory follow-up
summary.description: Run the Monitoring Plan decision for medication patients, wait for the DMN-specified BMP interval, check for the result, and notify the clinician if it is missing.

parameters.name: treatment_action
parameters.description: Treatment Recommendation Action bound from the approved plan at synthesis.

parameters.name: has_kidney_disease
parameters.description: Patient kidney-disease status bound from the approved plan at synthesis.

parameters.name: lab_timing
parameters.description: Required Monitoring Plan output interval for medication rows; no value is present when the decision says routine laboratory monitoring is not required.

parameters.name: notify_reason
parameters.default: The expected laboratory result was not available at the planned follow-up.
parameters.description: Reason shown to the responsible clinician.

parameters.name: max_duration
parameters.description: Maximum time allowed for this automation.

automatability.rationale: The monitoring decision and timing come from the linked decision model; the remaining steps are result lookup and notification.
